## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Change is focused and bounded.
- [ ] Affected indexes, contracts, schemas, diagrams, and traceability references are updated.
- [ ] A material architecture or governance change includes an ADR.

## Authority and risk

Describe any effect on human decision authority, risk acceptance, approvals, requirements, release gates, evidence lineage, confidence semantics, or agent boundaries.

## Validation

List reviews, tests, schema checks, examples, or evidence used to validate the change.

## Licensing and provenance

- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under AGPL-3.0-only.
- [ ] Third-party material and licenses are identified.
- [ ] Commits include my human `Signed-off-by` DCO certification.
- [ ] AI-assisted content was reviewed by a human submitter.

## Remaining uncertainty

Document known limitations, disagreement, deferred work, and follow-on decisions.
